title: Neuschwanstein: ~$25 to enter. Beijing's Summer Palace? ~$4 | China Travel Expert
description:
Germany's fairy-tale castle costs about $25 to get in. Beijing's imperial lakeside palace? About $4.

Neuschwanstein Castle charges €21 + a €2.50 online booking fee (€23.50, ~US$25). The Summer Palace's peak-season entry (1 Apr–31 Oct) is ¥30 — about US$4 — for 300 hectares of lake, pavilions, the Long Corridor and Cixi's Marble Boat. The ¥60 'through-ticket' adds the Tower of Buddhist Incense and the interior halls.

🧭 Expert Tip: buy the ¥60 through-ticket if you want inside the halls and the tower — the ¥30 ticket is grounds only, and some interiors close on Mondays.
